text_blocks.snippet: A COVID-19 antigen test, often referred to as a rapid test, detects specific proteins (antigens) from the SARS-CoV-2 virus. These tests are relatively quick, producing results in 5-30 minutes. While they are good at detecting the virus when viral load is high (e.g., in symptomatic individuals), they are less sensitive than molecular tests (like PCR tests) when the viral load is low or in early stages of infection. For this reason, repeat testing (serial testing) is often recommended, especially for those without symptoms or when testing negative.
